attribution.note: Zitron's own sentence in his own post, stated in his own voice.

semantics.note: The proposition keeps the 'props up the economy' framing, which the contract treats as rhetoric. It also changes 'primarily so that they can start losing money' (the buyers' purpose) into 'companies that lose money' (who the buyers are). Observation is the right kind.

contract.note: Using fiscal 2025 and Data Center share for 'most of its money' is an ordinary reading. Element 2 needs evidence of what buyers use GPUs for and whether those uses lose money. That is fair to his words but depends on interpretation.

evidence.note: FY25 Data Center revenue was $115.2B of $130.5B, about 88%. This supports element 1 only. It is a company disclosure, and the segment includes networking.
FY25 total revenue of $130.5B, the denominator for the Data Center share. Supports element 1 only.
OpenAI's projected 2024 loss shows that loss-making GPU-dependent software buyers exist. It does not show they are NVIDIA's main buyers or why buyers purchase GPUs.

reviews.rationale: Element 1 holds: Data Center sales were about 88% of FY25 revenue. Element 2, that buyers mainly buy GPUs to run loss-making software, has no evidence on customer mix or buyers' AI profitability, and the packet says so. The support condition needs both elements, and nothing contradicts element 2, so the overall result is unresolved.

attribution.note: Zitron's own words in his own post.

semantics.note: The paraphrase is close. But 'we still can't find a clean way to say' is an evaluative, rhetorical judgement with no measurable standard, so it is rhetoric, not an observation.

contract.note: The contract rightly treats the claim as untestable: 'clean way', 'we' and 'why it matters' have no measure, and it leaves usage questions to another claim.

evidence.note: Pew survey showing concrete reported uses (work, learning). It informs the debate but cannot test whether a 'clean' account exists.

reviews.rationale: This is a rhetorical, evaluative claim with no objective test for a 'clean way to say' what ChatGPT does or why it matters. Usage data is context only. Not adjudicable.

attribution.note: Zitron's own sentence in his own post.

semantics.note: The proposition captures the compute spending, the multibillion losses and the claimed need for further Microsoft money to survive. The Xbox and monopoly parts are rightly excluded.

contract.note: Calendar 2024 for the financial flows and dependence measured at publication is a fair, ordinary reading. Requiring proof that Microsoft money was necessary follows from his own words 'requiring' and 'keep them alive'.

evidence.note: Press-confirmed projection of about a $5B 2024 loss, made in September 2024, with some exclusions. Consistent with 'billions' but not a realized figure, and silent on dependence on Microsoft.
SoftBank's company disclosure of up to $40B in conditional follow-on investment. It weakens the idea of exclusive reliance on Microsoft but does not show OpenAI could survive without Microsoft.

reviews.rationale: Multibillion losses are consistent with a press-reported projection, but no realized financials were obtained. No liquidity or financing records show that further Microsoft money was needed at publication. SoftBank's commitment suggests other funding sources but does not disprove need. Unresolved.

attribution.note: Zitron's own words in his own post.

semantics.note: The financial part ('doesn't make any money') is an observation. 'It sucks' / 'bad product' is a subjective value judgement and cannot be scored.

contract.note: Zero realized revenue is the literal reading and profit is allowed as an alternative. The words may be hyperbole for negligible money, so the result depends on interpretation. Excluding deal counts as proof of revenue is strict but stated.

evidence.note: Salesforce says it closed 3,000+ paid Agentforce deals in Q4 FY25. This is a company disclosure that strongly suggests some revenue, but under the contract deal counts alone do not show realized revenue or profit.

reviews.rationale: No Agentforce-only realized revenue or profit figure for the target quarter is in the packet. The paid-deal count weighs against zero revenue, but the contract says deal counts alone cannot contradict. 'It sucks' cannot be scored. Unresolved.
